title: Third density-split transition
description: Proves the all-moduli Dirichlet boundary 174797/200000 = 0.873985, with the principal pole excluded. This is Sil's density-split proof (PR 83, sil-density-split-20261026) with one more variable-density transition G(4967/5000, 49/20, 1/10) -> G(99/100, 239/100, 1/10) (selection A = 3/5, D = 35, s0 = 17/300), certified by the same thirteen exact scalar gates and density floor with Bernstein certificates on v in [0, 13/300]. The final all-shift physical return is re-certified at h = 16109/20000 with count face C = (99/100, 239/100, 9999/100000) and physical face P = (99/100, 239/100, 31/500), 16 admission windows (one re-tiled) and 29 exact Bernstein rows. All analytic content, the generic step machinery and the return framework are Sil's, ArviFoxy's (PR 76), Hailey Collet's (PR 69) and OpenAI's; inherited authorship and license notices are retained. The research, certificate generation and Lean changes were AI-assisted (Claude).
